title: search.queried v1 payload
description: An opted-in account ran a search (Tara Intelligence WP 8.7-B2). Carries only sha256 hex digests of the normalized query tokens (tara_common.signal_terms.term_keys, at most 8); the query text never leaves search. Emitted by search only while feed's intel.search_signal.changed says enabled, behind SEARCH_EMIT_QUERY_SIGNALS (default on). Consumer: feed (maps the digests to topic ids and keeps the topics of the last 3 queries in the current visit; stores no digest).
